limitations: Only synthetic UUID Development zones and lab directories were used; production and canonical Dev notebooks were not opened.
Manual pass durations do not measure APNs/background scheduling or native editor paint.
Cross-device stages are separated by launch/restoration; do not sum them as continuous edit-to-screen latency.
CloudKit request wrappers include SDK/delegate work and any retry waits, not only network/server time.
Physical normal Dev restore build was current source version 0.6.0; installed Dev version before test was 0.5.0; no source version bump.
CloudKit timings are small-fixture Debug runs and are not directly comparable to Release model benchmarks.
